mechanism: Foscarnet and ritonavir both cause significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia), with additive renal and mineral metabolism risks.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate), and hydration status closely; consider alternative antiretroviral if possible; ensure adequate saline hydration with foscarnet dosing.
